title: Pendulum tempo
description: A metal pendulum and sliding counterweight make an adjustable beat visible.
useCase: A visual tempo reference for rehearsing timing or motion cadence.
interaction: Start the pendulum and change its tempo
reducedMotion: The pendulum stays upright; tempo controls remain available.
limitations: Visual-only tempo; no audio click or sample-accurate clock. Changing tempo retimes the CSS cycle and may shift its phase.
look: Skeuomorphic pale-metal device with soft bevels and a dark green recessed face holding a silver pendulum, tempo scale and counterweight, above round plus-minus buttons.
motion: Pressing play swings the arm ±24° in an infinite ease-in-out loop, one swing per beat; the tempo buttons step 4 BPM, retiming the cycle and sliding the weight.
adapt: The swing is the `sf-tempo-swing` keyframes on `sf-tempo-arm`, timed by `--period` (`120 / bpm` seconds) with `cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1)` and toggled via `data-running`; `--weight-position` maps `bpm` to the weight. Adjust the 40–180 range and tick labels together.
